name: Claude Message Threads
summary: Make long-running Claude agents respond faster by sending only new messages each turn instead of the whole history. Public beta on the Claude API with a Python SDK helper, and on by default in most Claude Code sessions.

name: Gemini Computer Use
summary: Build agents that test web apps, fill forms, and control desktop or mobile interfaces from screenshots. Now generally available through the Gemini API, with sample code for connecting it to your own browser automation.

name: Mistral Large 4
summary: Build coding agents and security-fix tools on an open-weight model that Mistral says tops open models for agentic coding. Download the weights from Hugging Face or call the API at about $1.36 per million input tokens.

name: Sound Effects v3
summary: Generate sound effects for games, videos, and apps from a text prompt, including scenes with several sounds in sequence. Cleaner audio with fewer artifacts, available now in the ElevenLabs app and API.

name: Replica
summary: Turn plain-language ideas into clickable prototypes built from your own design system's components. Free and open source under MIT, with an optional self-hosted hub for sharing prototypes and collecting comments.

name: LFM3
summary: Run small open-weight models for text, vision, and audio on a phone or laptop, then fine-tune them on a single GPU. Download from Hugging Face in GGUF or MLX, free for commercial use under $10M revenue.

name: GPT-6.1 Terra
summary: Run coding, computer-use, and visual tasks faster with a mid-tier model priced at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output. Use it via the API as gpt-6.1-terra, or in Codex and ChatGPT Work on paid plans.

name: Riverside Agents
summary: Turn recordings into edited episodes, social clips, captions, and scheduled posts with four AI agents. Available on web and iPhone across all Riverside plans, with a 14-day trial and your approval before anything is published.
